name: entityId
description: Stable identifier for the artifact this tree belongs to. Used as a key for expansion-state persistence.

name: files
description: Array of tree nodes. Each node has name, path, type ('file' | 'directory'), and optional children.

name: selectedPath
description: Currently selected file path. Pass null when nothing is selected.

name: onSelect
description: Called with the full path whenever the user selects a file via click or keyboard.

name: onAddFile
description: Optional callback for the 'add file' affordance. Hidden when not provided or when readOnly.

name: onDeleteFile
description: Optional callback for deleting a file. Hidden when not provided or when readOnly.

name: isLoading
description: Render a skeleton placeholder while the tree is being fetched.

name: readOnly
description: Hide create/delete affordances while preserving selection and expand/collapse.

name: ariaLabel
description: Accessible label announced by screen readers for the tree region.
